info.title: Subregator API
info.description: Read-only provider inventory comparison. Unknown values remain null or omitted; amounts are integers with explicit currency scale. Quotes are separate from resources. A zero fee means confirmed zero; null means unknown. Public responses contain normalized fields only, never raw provider payloads. Offers are observations, not reservations. Durable listing history and free network observations are exposed through REST and MCP Streamable HTTP. Marketplace providers are not necessarily resource owners.

get.summary: Inspect a public IP, subnet or ASN using free public sources
get.description: Read stored observations only. This endpoint never runs or refreshes external checks. Checks without a cached observation remain pending; automatic checks cover published catalogue prefixes. Historical parameter combinations and standalone IP/ASN queries may have no stored observation. BGP and RPKI include normalized explanations. RPKI findings distinguish observed origins from a proposed ASN, individual invalid ASN/length and partial coverage. No unknown, stale or partial finding establishes a passing result. Optional irr exposes source-scoped IRR consistency. It returns not_configured by default and not_applicable for unsupported query scope (IPv4 shorter than /9, IPv6 shorter than /29, IP or ASN). Cached public reads never enable collection. Optional abuse returns cached AbuseIPDB summaries only after an approved account/key and display/retention gate is configured. It supports current IPv4 /24-/31 or IPv6 /120-/127 with a fixed 30-day window and at most 256 addresses; single-host, broader, historical, version and proposed-ASN combinations are not applicable. plan_limited distinguishes account entitlement errors from missing reports. Optional spamhaus_zen returns independent SBL/XBL/PBL findings for one queried IP. For a prefix, only its first address is queried, with explicit partial coverage except single-host prefixes. PBL is outbound mail policy. A negative sample never establishes whole-prefix absence or safety. Licensed HTTPS product access and display/retention rights are required; off by default. access_denied distinguishes source authorization failures. DROP remains a separate complete overlap check.

get.summary: Compare observed subnet offers and exact-prefix price/lifecycle history
get.description: Read-only PostgreSQL/catalogue projection. Current offers, historical provider associations, lifecycle/price events and provider inventory attempts remain separate. Current offers include every availability state and explicit freshness. Model/currency/term filters affect price projections; raw before/after lifecycle evidence is preserved, including transitions out of a filter. Separate current/history/poll cursors must each be consumed. Historical disclosure follows current provider policy; Peaktera history remains private, and current Peaktera offers still expire after one hour. Canonical CIDRs overlap only by containment or equality; no fourth non-nested CIDR overlap relation is invented. Disappearance is not a sale, multiple sellers do not establish common ownership or fraud, and no continuous price validity between observations is claimed.

get.summary: Look up a public IP, subnet or ASN on demand
get.description: Reuse fresh cached observations and collect missing or expired checks from free sources. No authentication required. Shares process request admission, four concurrent inspections, a 12-second deadline and the configured upstream request budget. Reports may be partial; inspect every metric status, coverage and freshness. Network-disabled mode makes no external requests. Supports asn_relationships and announced_prefixes in checks. Checks include geolocation database estimates, incremental per-address DNSBL collection for at most 256 addresses, public Globalping ping/traceroute jobs (EU/NA/AS, three probes), and bounded HTTP throughput with test_url. Pending measurements resume on later calls; inspect status, observation.completeness and data for actual coverage. The default prefix measurement address is a sample, not whole-prefix reachability. Active measurements can consume the upstream free quota.

get.summary: Read durable check observations and inferred changes
get.description: Cached-only, exact known public CIDR. Current provider disclosure and history-check approval apply to all rows. Disabled, hidden and unknown resource histories return empty items. Stable ingestion-ID pagination; late source observations are retained without retroactive inferred events. previous_seen and observed_at bound inferred changes, not exact event dates. first_seen/last_seen bound recorded sightings of the same normalized state; gap indicates uncertain continuity. Freshness is as captured, never current approval.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Exact public IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR

order_url.description: Provider order link for this exact block and billing term, when supplied.

refresh_after_utc.description: Optional daily UTC polling window start (HH:MM); the minimum refresh interval still applies.

max_current_age_seconds.description: Optional maximum age of current data. Expired offers require explicit fresh_only=false and carry a stale freshness label.

retry_at.description: Earliest retry allowed by a persisted source Retry-After response, if known.

automatic.description: Whether the automatic worker collects this metric for eligible published prefixes. DROP is a separate automatic offer check.

OfferChecks.description: Automatically collected source-scoped results for a published prefix. Reading offers never triggers a check. Pending, stale and unavailable results are not passing checks. Omitted for withheld prefixes.

Observation.description: Additive evidence envelope. Collection success is not a passing finding. Completeness is bounded to the named source and scope; unknown never establishes complete coverage.

scheduler_sweep_floor_seconds.description: Retained for compatibility and zero with per_check_ttl scheduling: there is no artificial prefix-sweep pacing floor. Use due/running jobs and measured ages; zero is not a freshness guarantee.

CollectionStatus.description: Process-local collection health for per-check TTL scheduling. Source Retry-After and DROP reservations survive cache eviction in separate storage. Counters reset on restart; no prefixes, credentials or arbitrary upstream URLs are returned.

date.description: Validated source date, preserved as RFC3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD. Day-only values are not converted into invented timestamps.

Registration.description: Normalized current registry evidence; record range and source distinguish exact, covering and partial query coverage. Network name, registered entity, seller and origin ASN are separate concepts. Contacts are published but not verified; source dates do not prove ownership or selling authority.

BGPExplanation.description: RIS prefix observation. A covering relation without prefix means the source did not identify the actual covering route. Filtering and collector coverage are not global reachability.

RoutingVisibility.description: Separately dated routing-status evidence for the requested resource. Peer counts are RIS visibility, not collector counts or a reachability guarantee. First/last seen may describe a containing route; its prefix is retained.

OriginValidation.description: Current prefix/ASN validation. not_found is not invalid. Empty covering_roas means none were supplied in a supported shape, not proof that no ROA exists. At most 32 supplied covering ROAs are shown; validity is the source finding, not recomputed from this explanation list.

RPKIExplanation.description: Current validation, never historical validation. Complete describes supplied origin pairs within RIS visibility; it is not global coverage. Any missing, malformed, failed or omitted origin yields partial. proposed_asn is a separate customer-supplied prefix/ASN pair, not an observed origin. Freshness is carried by the parent observation; stale findings never pass.

url.description: Public link to the original registry or its export index.

timestamp_kind.description: updated_at is the last local IRRd data change, not an upstream object modification date or last successful poll.

IRRRegistry.description: IRRd per-registry data-change timestamp and attribution. Local age ceiling is 24 hours; missing or old dates cannot establish a passing comparison. This is not proof of upstream mirror health or object creation time.

metadata_url.description: Public documentation of mirror coverage and provenance; the private GraphQL endpoint is omitted. Registry timestamps are embedded in this explanation.

IRRExplanation.description: Route/route6 observations from the private Subregator IRRd mirror, compared with separately dated RIS origins. Coverage is RIPE, RIPE-NONAUTH, ARIN, APNIC, LACNIC and AFRINIC; RADB and other registries are absent. Duplicate and conflicting registrations are preserved; covering or contained routes never satisfy an exact-prefix origin. Unknown, stale, truncated or incomplete evidence never establishes a passing comparison. Raw RPSL, contact fields and the private mirror address are never published. Public REST/MCP reads use cached observations and do not query IRRd.

ReportedAddress.description: A source-reported IP summary, not a raw complaint. source_confidence is AbuseIPDB's assertion, not a subnet score or a finding about the current tenant. Missing report timestamps remain missing.

AbuseObservation.description: Optional, default-off IPv4 /24-/31 and IPv6 /120-/127 check-block summary with at most 256 addresses. Query window bounds are local request bounds, not an exact source clock. Counts and latest known timestamp are derived only from retained source summaries. Subset ranges, missing/invalid timestamps, duplicates, continuation and truncation are partial; counts are lower bounds. Zero reports does not prove cleanliness. Aging out is not resolution. Past reports are not attributed to a current tenant. No raw complaint text, reporter identity, categories or additional per-IP detail requests are included.

address.description: The single queried IPv4/IPv6 address; never a claimed listing range.

QuoteCosts.description: Totals for one quoted billing period, including all reported unconditional charges and taxes only when included. First period includes setup and deposit; renewal excludes once-only fees. Null plus reasons when unknown, conditional, mixed-currency or overflowing int64. Minimum term and refundable status remain in quote. No implied absence of unreported costs.

price_scope.description: Actual offered prefix; quote totals always cover this scope, not necessarily the requested subnet

ProviderAssociation.description: Historical provider association with the exact public prefix, independent of current listing presence. Not ownership.

MarketPoll.description: Provider inventory attempt, not proof that the requested prefix was offered at that time. Failed/incomplete attempts are coverage gaps; no raw error is exposed.

QuotedTotal.description: Calculated quoted charges in source currency with aligned minor-unit scale; exact nonnegative int64, distinct from the per-source-price bound.

evidence.description: Normalized source-scoped evidence only; no raw responses. Null for failed or malformed checks. DROP includes source copyright and update date.

attempted_at.description: Immutable local collection-attempt time, independent of ingestion/replay

next_cursor.description: Pass as after_id; omitted at end
